body.name: Pi
body.def: For \(j=(C,s)\in J\), \(\Pi_j(\rho,\theta_j,h_s)=Q(c_s-a_j(\rho)h_s)^{-1}\int_{c_s-a_j(\rho)h_s}^{\infty}\phi(z)Q((q_{\alpha,j}(\rho,\theta_j)-d_j(\theta_j)h_s-r_j(\rho,\theta_j)z)/v_j(\rho,\theta_j))\,dz\); this is power conditional on the complete signed event \(E_{n,C}(\rho)\)
